title: PatchPreferences
description: What the user said about preferences between their mods, for one game.

answers.description:
The user's answers to preferences learned and offered, by the
preference's identity.

applied.description:
The decisions made by applying a preference, by their key among the
decisions: the identity of the preference that made each.

learningOff.description:
Whether the user switched learning off: then only the preferences
they set themselves count, and nothing is offered.

rules.description: The preferences the user set themselves.

PreferenceAnswer.description: The user's answer to a preference offered.

at.description:
How many decisions the preference rested on then, so that "not
now" can be asked again once there are more.

PreferenceAnswerKind.description: The answers to a preference offered.

oneOf.description: Applied to the open conflicts; it keeps counting.
Not now: asked again once more decisions speak for it.
Never: neither offered again nor used.

PreferenceRule.description: A preference the user set: one mod kept over others.

mod.description: The mod preferred, by the name the mod manager shows.

over.description: The one mod it is preferred over; `None` for every other mod.

topic.description:
What it is preferred for (`meshes`, `textures`, `faces`, `files`,
`places`); `None` for everything.
